text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vice President Godfrey Miyanda has ruled out a possible military coup in Zambia as speculated by the media.
- The government has threatened to suspend the operations of Zambia Express to Johannesburg should to airline fail to normalise its flight operations.
- The University of Zambia has reinstated eight out of a total of 12 students expelled after riots over delayed meal allowances.
- Parliament has adjourned sine die after nearly three months of debate on the 1997 budget.
- Police say they will not interfer with prostitutes in the capital provided they behave themselves.
